instruction: A candid medium shot of an elegant indoor room with patterned wallpaper and wooden trim. On the left, the man in the dark blue suit (R1) stands in profile, looking down at their hands. On the right, the bald man with glasses in the blue suit (R2) stands facing him, also looking down. They are engaged in a warm handshake, with the bald man (R2) clasping the other man's (R1) right hand with both of his hands. Warm indoor lighting from a wall lamp illuminates the scene, creating soft shadows and a natural color palette.
